schema_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS DOCUMENT_QUEUE (D_ID INT PRIMARY KEY, DOCUMENT_ID INT, COPIES INT, REQUESTOR VARCHAR(255), QUEUE_DATE DATETIME, PRINT_LOCATION INT)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS CORRESPONDENCE_JOURNAL (CORRESPONDENCE_ID INT PRIMARY KEY, DOCUMENT_ID INT, FILE_NUMBER INT)
generation_sql: INSERT INTO DOCUMENT_QUEUE (D_ID, DOCUMENT_ID, COPIES, REQUESTOR, QUEUE_DATE, PRINT_LOCATION) SELECT n, n, MOD(n, 10), CONCAT('Requestor_', n), DATEADD(DAY, -MOD(n, 30), GETDATE()), 2 FROM generated_numbers WHERE n <= {row_count}
INSERT INTO CORRESPONDENCE_JOURNAL (CORRESPONDENCE_ID, DOCUMENT_ID, FILE_NUMBER) SELECT n, MOD(n, 5000), n FROM generated_numbers WHERE n <= {row_count}

tables.name: DOCUMENT_QUEUE
tables.purpose: Primary table for the query, representing the document queue.
tables.distribution_notes: Uniform distribution of DOCUMENT_ID, skewed QUEUE_DATE for recent entries.

tables.name: CORRESPONDENCE_JOURNAL
tables.purpose: Secondary table for the query, representing correspondence records.
tables.distribution_notes: Uniform distribution of FILE_NUMBER, many-to-one relationship with DOCUMENT_QUEUE.

calibration_queries.sql: SELECT TOP 1 dc.DOCUMENT_ID, dc.COPIES, dc.REQUESTOR, dc.D_ID, cj.FILE_NUMBER FROM DOCUMENT_QUEUE dc JOIN CORRESPONDENCE_JOURNAL cj ON dc.DOCUMENT_ID = cj.DOCUMENT_ID WHERE dc.QUEUE_DATE <= GETDATE() AND dc.PRINT_LOCATION = 2 ORDER BY cj.FILE_NUMBER
calibration_queries.objective: Verify that the query plan includes Nested Loops and Table Spool operators.
expected_evidence: Nested Loops operator is visible in the plan.
Table Spool operator is visible in the plan.
